obfuscation_indicators: subject to certain risks and uncertainties
cautioned not to place undue reliance
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively detailed, with shipment, margin, capital expenditure, tax, restructuring, and credit-loss guidance. Management expresses a broadly positive outlook but flags macroeconomic, currency, pension, material-cost, consumer-behavior, and near-prime/sub-prime credit risks. Forward-looking safe-harbor language and broad caveats modestly reduce transparency around forecast uncertainty.
